macros.name: ctmbarc
macros.doc: represents a continuum of branches by an arc.

macros.name: ctmfillcolor
macros.doc: Color of triangle used to indicate continuum of branches.

macros.name: egactionboxsep
macros.doc: Distance between edge of box around action label and action label.

macros.name: egactionlabelsep
macros.doc: Spacing used to position box containing action label relative to branch.

macros.name: egalbox
macros.doc: Type of box for action labels.

macros.name: egalboxfillcolor
macros.doc: Color of fill of boxes containing action labels.

macros.name: egalboxfillstyle
macros.doc: Style of fill of boxes containing action labels.

macros.name: egalboxlinecolor
macros.doc: Color of lines around boxes containing action labels.

macros.name: egalboxlinestyle
macros.doc: Style of lines around boxes containing action labels.

macros.name: egalhshift
macros.doc: The positions of labels may need fine tuning, which may be achieved by setting either \egalhshift or \egalvshift or both to be nonzero (each is an integer, interpreted as a multiple of the unitlength).

macros.name: egalvshift
macros.doc: The positions of labels may need fine tuning, which may be achieved by setting either \egalhshift or \egalvshift or both to be nonzero (each is an integer, interpreted as a multiple of the unitlength).

macros.name: egarclinecolor
macros.doc: The style of the arc is controlled by the parameters \egarclinestyle (possible values solid, dashed, dotted, and none; default solid), \egarclinewidth (any dimension; default 0.6pt), \egarclinecolor (any color; default black).

macros.name: egarclinestyle
macros.doc: The style of the arc is controlled by the parameters \egarclinestyle (possible values solid, dashed, dotted, and none; default solid), \egarclinewidth (any dimension; default 0.6pt), \egarclinecolor (any color; default black).

macros.name: egarrowstyle
macros.doc: Style of arrows on branches.

macros.name: egdirection
macros.doc: Direction of game.

macros.name: eginode
macros.doc: Object used for initial node.

macros.name: egnode
macros.doc: Object used for nodes.

macros.name: egpaybox
macros.doc: Type of box for payoffs.

macros.name: egpayboxfillcolor
macros.doc: Color of fill of boxes containing payoffs.

macros.name: egpayboxfillstyle
macros.doc: Style of fill of boxes containing action payoffs.

macros.name: egpayboxlinecolor
macros.doc: Color of lines around boxes containing payoffs.

macros.name: egpayboxlinestyle
macros.doc: Style of lines around boxes containing payoffs.

macros.name: egpayoffboxsep
macros.doc: Distance between edge of box around payoffs and payoffs.

macros.name: egplayerboxsep
macros.doc: Distance between edge of box around player label and player label.

macros.name: egplayerlabelsep
macros.doc: Spacing used to position box containing player label relative to center of initial node, and relative to center of information set.

macros.name: egplbox
macros.doc: Type of box for player labels.

macros.name: egplboxfillcolor
macros.doc: Color of fill of boxes containing player labels.

macros.name: egplboxfillstyle
macros.doc: Style of fill of boxes containing player labels.

macros.name: egplboxlinecolor
macros.doc: Color of lines around boxes containing player labels.

macros.name: egplboxlinestyle
macros.doc: Style of lines around boxes containing player labels.

macros.name: infoset
macros.doc: draws an information set starting at (x-coord ,y-coord ), optionally with direction direction, of length length, with player label player-name.

macros.name: infosetdot
macros.doc: Object used for “dots” in information sets.

macros.name: infosetdotsep
macros.doc: Spacing between dots in information set, as a multiple of the unit length.

macros.name: initialfalse
macros.doc: To force a node to be initial, specify \initialtrue before it; to force a node to be noninitial, specify \initialfalse before it.

macros.name: initialtrue
macros.doc: Force a node other than the first one in an egame to be initial, or force the first node to be noninitial.

macros.name: putbranch
macros.doc: sets up the parameters for a branch at the point (x-coord ,y-coord ), with direction parameter (h-incr ,v-incr ), optional direction direction, and length length.
